definition: A sensory spot is a simple patch of sensory epithelium in the inner ear or related structures. In this historical account, it refers especially to the uncomplicated hearing-equilibrium patch found in fishes, contrasted with the more specialized organ that later develops into the cochlea in higher vertebrates.
